scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the School Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the Goa Labour Welfare Board
Applicant must have at least 6 months of continuous service with the Board at the time of application
Child must be enrolled in a recognized, aided, or private school
Preference is given to workers with no more than two children
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,600 per student per annum for the purchase of one uniform set (shorts/trousers and shirts for boys, frock for girls).
documents_required: Prescribed application form (print from the official website)
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
